command:
git commit -m "Convert dbg! debug output to file-append logging" -m "dbg! writes to stderr, which is owned by the terminal/REPL during a
session and hard to capture. Add a small debug module whose log_to_file
helper appends a timestamped line to a target chosen by HANIHI_DEBUG_FILE
(default ./hanihi-debug.log); all I/O failures are swallowed so debug
logging never breaks tool execution.

Replace the five dbg! call sites (get_time construction in tool.rs and
four parse_diff failure paths in write.rs) with tagged log_to_file calls.
Add unit tests for append behaviour, env-target selection, and the
best-effort path.

Note: folds in a pre-existing uncommitted refactor of builtin_apply_patch
that hoisted the tool JSON schema (unrelated to this change; preserved
as-is)."
